title: Simon Ch. 4, 3.14: the explicit mean curvature field is measurable and bounded on compact subsets of U
statement: Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, U and O open subsets of ℝ^P, N ⊆ O with (closure(N) ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, pr : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) of class C¹ on O, and p : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) μ-a.e. strongly measurable with ‖p(x)‖ ≤ 1 (operator norm) for all x. Then there is H : ℝ^P → ℝ^P that is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, bounded on every compact K ⊆ U (there is Λ with ‖H(x)‖ ≤ Λ for all x ∈ K), and satisfies H(x) = Σ_{j=1}^P (Dpr(x)[p(x)e_j])^*(p(x)e_j) for every x ∈ N ∩ U, where e_1, …, e_P is the standard basis of ℝ^P, Dpr(x) is the derivative of pr at x and T^* is the adjoint of T ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U N O : Set (Euclid P)) (pr p : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), IsOpen U → IsOpen O → N ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 pr O → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ H : Euclid P → Euclid P, AEStronglyMeasurable H μ ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ‖H x‖ ≤ Λ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ N ∩ U, H x = ∑ j : Fin P, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ pr x (p x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (p x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))
